title: An Adaptive Machine Learning Framework for Fluid Flow in Dual-Network Porous Media
summary: Porous materials -- natural or engineered -- often exhibit dual pore-network structures that govern processes such as mineral exploration and hydrocarbon recovery from tight shales. Double porosity/permeability (DPP) mathematical models describe incompressible fluid flow through two interacting pore networks with inter-network mass exchange. Despite significant advances in numerical methods, there remains a need for computational frameworks that enable rapid forecasting, data assimilation, and reliable inverse analysis.
